title: Nothing left at the root
literal_meaning: To wipe out at the root.
explanation: To eradicate, uproot or destroy completely, leaving nothing that could sustain it. The expression can also describe eliminating a problem at its root rather than dealing only with its surface effects.
meaning_odia: କୌଣସି ଜିନିଷକୁ ସମୂଳେ ଧ୍ୱଂସ କରିବା ବା ସମସ୍ୟାକୁ ମୂଳରୁ ଦୂର କରିବା। କେବଳ ଉପରୁ କିଛି ବଦଳାଇବା ନୁହେଁ, ତାହା ପୁଣି ରହିବା ବା ବଢ଼ିବାର ମୂଳକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ହଟାଇଦେବାର ତୀବ୍ର ଅର୍ଥ ଏଥିରେ ଅଛି।
usage_example: A flood has destroyed a family’s stored seed, tools and the shed itself; a neighbour uses the expression to describe the extent of the loss. (Original imagined occasion, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: ଖୋଳ କରିବା carries the same meaning of complete destruction.
odia_summary: ସାମାନ୍ୟ କ୍ଷତି ନୁହେଁ, ସମୂଳେ ଧ୍ୱଂସ କରିବାର ତୀବ୍ର ଅର୍ଥ।
english_summary: An emphatic expression for destruction that leaves nothing at the root.

variants.note: ଖୋଳ କରିବା: ସମୂଳେ ଧ୍ୱଂସ କରିବା। To destroy completely. Source pairs the two expressions under one gloss; no additional entry count.
